name: How soon can I use my room after carpet installation?

mainEntity.name: How soon can I use my room after carpet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can typically use your room immediately after carpet installation is complete. There is no curing or drying time required for the carpet itself, unlike some other flooring types. However, we recommend being mindful of any moved furniture and allowing a short period for air circulation to dissipate any new carpet odors, which are usually mild and temporary.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can generally use your room right after carpet installation, as there is no drying time required, but allow for some air circulation.
